anchors.statement: The sc-agent consumer template must be built from the plan-anchor shared client after that client is defined and working.
anchors.quote: define/build the shared client layer (on plan-anchor) first.  once the layer is defined and working, then build sc-compose template to generate it.
anchors.scope: Sprints that build the shared plan-anchor client or the sc-agent consumer template.
anchors.deterministic_check: Compare the completed client revision with the template source and sprint ordering.

pass: Build and test the plan-anchor shared client, then derive the sc-agent template from it.
fail: Build the sc-agent template before implementing the shared plan-anchor client.

history.previous_statement: The sc-agent consumer template must be built from the plan-anchor client after the client passes its tests.

anchors.statement: The plan-anchor shared-client integration must preserve all existing plan-anchor functionality.
anchors.quote: integration w/ current plan-anchor (so plan anchor is unchanged functionally) on plan anchor
anchors.scope: The plan-anchor sprint that integrates the shared client into existing plan-anchor features.
anchors.deterministic_check: Run existing plan-anchor behavior and installation tests against the integrated client.

pass: Integrate the shared client and keep existing plan-anchor commands and behavior working.
fail: Replace plan-anchor behavior with a reduced set of commands.

history.previous_statement: The plan-anchor shared-client integration must preserve existing plan-anchor command behavior.

anchors.statement: The judge-jev track must use the template and preserve its current features before adding sitr support.
anchors.quote: judge-jev : template -> current features -> sitr support
anchors.scope: Judge-jev template adoption, feature parity and sitr integration sprints.
anchors.deterministic_check: Inspect the judge-jev sprint order and run feature and sitr tests.

pass: Adopt the shared template and preserve judge-jev features before adding sitr.
fail: Add sitr first and defer all existing judge-jev feature integration.

history.previous_statement: The judge-jev integration must preserve its existing features before adding sitr support.

anchors.statement: Manual live integration runs must use unit tests with real providers, reusing existing mocked tests where applicable.
anchors.quote: I expect integration tests to be build as unit tests (ideally tests that already exist using mocks).  they are simply run w/ live agents and triggered manually.
anchors.summary: Reuse existing tests for live runs
anchors.scope: Sprints that implement or run live integration tests for sc-agent or its consumers.
anchors.deterministic_check: Inspect live and controlled test selections and run the existing unit suite.

pass: Run existing mocked unit tests manually against real providers for integration.
fail: Create an unrelated live-only test suite and retain the old unit tests separately.

history.previous_statement: Live integration runs must reuse existing unit tests with real provider calls.

anchors.statement: The integration test process must commit and push its test report.
anchors.quote: The test report MUST be committed/pushed as part of the integration test process.
anchors.scope: Sprints defining or executing the integration test reporting process.
anchors.deterministic_check: Inspect the integration run procedure and the resulting git commit and remote.

pass: Commit and push the generated integration report during the integration run.
fail: Leave the integration report only on the local machine.

history.previous_statement: Each integration test run must commit and push its XHTML report.

anchors.statement: One successful integration test run on one supported platform must satisfy the platform requirement.
anchors.quote: integration testing should be set up flexably where ONE integration test run should be required (one platform) which would typically be this mac or colima.
anchors.scope: Sprints defining integration test platform requirements or acceptance.
anchors.deterministic_check: Run the integration procedure with exactly one supported platform result.

pass: Accept one passing macOS run as the required platform run.
fail: Require both macOS and Windows runs before the platform requirement is satisfied.

history.previous_statement: A single successful integration test run must satisfy the platform requirement.

anchors.statement: Any phase-b test identified as flaky must be redesigned using controlled inputs.
anchors.quote: Flaky tests are prohibited by design. Any flaky test identified (one that relies on a race, timing, sleeps, event-loop ordering or load) must be re-designed to be deterministic by driving the logic with controlled inputs.
anchors.scope: Sprints that add or change tests.
anchors.deterministic_check: Review changed tests for timing, sleep and event-order dependence.

pass: Replace the timing-dependent test with controlled synchronization.
fail: Repeat the flaky test until a timing race passes.

history.previous_statement: Phase-b tests must use controlled inputs instead of relying on timing or scheduling races.

anchors.statement: After the shared plan-anchor client is complete, the sc-agent, plan-anchor and judge-jev work must be planned as three parallel tracks.
anchors.quote: 3 parallel tracks once plan-anchor client is complete.  template -> integration tests (sc-agent)  || integration w/ current plan-anchor (so plan anchor is unchanged functionally) on plan anchor || judge-jev : template -> current features -> sitr support
anchors.scope: The phase-b plan and sprints following completion of the shared plan-anchor client.
anchors.deterministic_check: Inspect the sprint graph and the lead dispatch order.

pass: After the shared client is complete, schedule sc-agent, plan-anchor and judge-jev as parallel tracks with their stated prerequisites.
fail: Run all plan-anchor work to completion before starting either other track.

history.previous_statement: The sc-agent, plan-anchor and judge-jev tracks must run in parallel after the shared plan-anchor client is complete.

anchors.statement: The integration test process must produce one XHTML report for each platform tested.
anchors.quote: There should be one xhtml report per platform tested.
anchors.summary: One XHTML report per tested platform
anchors.scope: Sprints defining integration test reports and platform coverage.
anchors.deterministic_check: Inspect the report output from separate platform runs.

pass: Render one XHTML integration report for each tested platform.
fail: Combine the results from every tested platform into a single report.

anchors.statement: No sc-agent crate's Cargo.toml may depend on a crate in a higher layer, where the layers from the bottom are: types; config, secrets and log; http; decision schema; decision backends (sc-decision-local over sc-decision-systemone, sc-decision-llm over sc-llm-provider); runner.
anchors.quote: Layers from the bottom: `sc-agent-types`; `sc-agent-config`, `sc-agent-secrets` and `sc-agent-log`; `sc-agent-http`; `sc-decision-schema`; the decision backends `sc-decision-systemone`, `sc-decision-local` and `sc-decision-llm` (over `sc-llm-provider`); `sc-decision-runner`, which handles decision models only.
anchors.context: Previously approved phase-a anchor; governing record remains approved in phase-b
anchors.summary: No crate depends on a crate above it in the layering
anchors.scope: adds or changes a crate dependency in a Cargo.toml

pass: sc-agent-http's Cargo.toml depends only on sc-agent-types, sc-agent-secrets and sc-agent-log, all lower layers; the only crate that depends on sc-decision-runner is decidr, which sits above the runner.
fail: sc-agent-types adds sc-decision-schema to its [dependencies] so it can name DecisionRequest.

anchors.statement: Every error returned by a public sc-agent function must carry the id and message of each lower-layer error that caused it.
anchors.quote: An error MUST carry the error id and message of every lower-layer error that caused it.
anchors.context: Previously approved phase-a anchor; governing record remains approved in phase-b
anchors.summary: Each crate returns its own error union carrying lower errors
anchors.scope: adds or changes an error type or a public function's return type

pass: HttpError::Network wraps the ureq error and a test asserts the outer error's chain carries the ureq error's id and message.
fail: The backend maps every lower-layer failure to a new error with the message "request failed", dropping the original error.

anchors.statement: No type, field or constant in the sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema crates must be specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or another application built on sc-agent.
anchors.quote: `sc-agent-types` and `sc-decision-schema` MUST NOT contain types specific to plan-anchor, judge-jev or any other consumer application.
anchors.context: Previously approved phase-a anchor; governing record remains approved in phase-b
anchors.summary: No consumer-app or Jev-mock types in shared crates
anchors.scope: adds or changes a type in sc-agent-types or sc-decision-schema

pass: Add the TypeSafe API request and response types to sc-decision-schema; no type, field or constant names plan-anchor or judge-jev.
fail: sc-agent-types adds a PlanAnchorVerdict enum for the plan-anchor gate.

anchors.statement: sc-agent source code must not call std::thread::sleep, tokio::time::sleep or any other sleep function.
anchors.quote: sc-agent source code MUST NOT call `std::thread::sleep`, `std::thread::sleep_until`, `tokio::time::sleep` or any other sleep function.
anchors.context: Previously approved phase-a anchor; governing record remains approved in phase-b
anchors.summary: No sleep calls in sc-agent source
anchors.scope: adds or changes Rust source in an sc-agent crate

pass: The sc-agent runner waits out holdoffs with CancelToken::wait_until and a clippy rule forbids sleep calls.
fail: The sc-agent retry loop calls std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1)) between attempts.
